LK1.claim: Lakshadweep's 36 islands cover just 32 sq km, with 4,200 sq km of lagoons; its waters hold about 600 fish species and 78 kinds of coral.

evidence.quote: Spanning 32 square kilometres across 36 scenic islands, adorned by a sprawling 4200 square kilometres of vibrant lagoons
Lakshadweep's ocean houses around 600 diverse fish species , 78 varieties of corals, and 82 types of seaweed.

LK_PERMIT.claim: Tourists need permission to visit Lakshadweep, foreign nationals may not visit some islands, and alcohol is allowed only on Bangaram.

evidence.quote: Tourists require permission to visit Lakshadweep and foreign nationals are not permitted to visit certain islands.
alcoholic beverage consumption is not permitted on the islands, except on Bangaram.

LK2.claim: Agatti has the islands' only airstrip and is the entry point for most visitors; ships sail from Kochi.

evidence.quote: Agatti (island’s only airstrip) serves as the entry point for most visitors to Lakshadweep.
You can reach Minicoy by ship from Kochi.

LK3.claim: Try kilanji, a thin rice-and-egg crepe with coconut milk; Kolkali and Parichakali are the islands' folk dances, and Minicoy has its own Lava dance.

evidence.quote: Indulge in the delicate delight of Kilanji, a paper-thin crepe crafted from rice and eggs
Dancing with the spirit of the islands, Kolkali and Parichakali embody the vibrant folk-art scene of Lakshadweep.

KAV1.claim: Kavaratti, the capital, about 400 km off Kochi, has 52 mosques including the carved Ujra Mosque, and a calm lagoon good for first dives.

evidence.quote: Situated around 400 km off the Indian coast from Kochi
Explore the island's soul through its 52 mosques
including the ornate Ujra Mosque with its intricate wood carvings
The calm lagoon is a dream come true for scuba diving beginners.

KAV2.claim: Dive Kavaratti's Harbour Mouth, Governor's Reef and the Wall of Wonder; most scuba is in the southern islands.

evidence.quote: Head to Governor's Reef, a haven for soft coral enthusiasts
The Wall of Wonder on the northwest side boasts thrilling underwater caverns
Scuba Diving adventures are mostly concentrated in the southern islands, the most popular spot being Kavaratti.

AGT1.claim: Agatti, with the only airstrip, has white beaches, lagoons and coral; its Golden Jubilee Museum shows a Minicoy sailboat model and shipwreck finds.

evidence.quote: Agatti (island’s only airstrip) serves as the entry point for most visitors to Lakshadweep.
explore the Golden Jubilee Museum, which houses a model of a traditional Minicoy sailboat

BAN1.claim: Bangaram is a 120-acre teardrop island with no permanent residents, a short boat ride from Agatti, ringed by lagoon and reef.

evidence.quote: Accessible by a short boat ride from Agatti
Covering 120 acres, Bangaram Island is devoid of permanent res
This teardrop-shaped paradise

MIN1.claim: Minicoy has its own culture and Lava dance, and an 1885 lighthouse you can climb; the five-day Samudram cruise from Kochi visits Kavaratti, Kalpeni and Minicoy.

evidence.quote: Witness the captivating rhythms of the lava dance
climbing the 1885 Minicoy Lighthouse
This five-day cruise visits the islands of Kavaratti, Kalpeni, and Minicoy

KAL1.claim: Kalpeni, 287 km west of Kochi, forms an atoll with Tilakkam and Pitti; its 2.79 sq km lagoon is great for snorkelling.

evidence.quote: Nestled 287 kilometres (178 miles) west of Kochi
Two small islets, Tilakkam and Pitti, form a single atoll with Kalpeni.
The island is surrounded by a vast lagoon spanning 2.79 square kilometres

DD1.claim: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu blends Indian and Portuguese culture: forts and churches in Daman and Diu, forests and tribal art around Silvassa.

evidence.quote: a unique blend of Indian and Portuguese cultures, the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu offers a one-of-a-kind escape

DAM1.claim: Daman, the capital of the UT, is a former Portuguese colony with cobbled lanes, forts and beaches.

evidence.quote: Daman, the charming capital of the union territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
This quaint city, a former Portuguese colony

MDF1.claim: Moti Daman Fort was built 1559–1581 under the Portuguese and covers about 30,000 sq m, enclosing the Cathedral of Bom Jesus and two lighthouses.

evidence.quote: The building of Moti Daman Fort began in 1559 AD and was completed in 1581 AD
Covering an expansive area of 30,000 square meters
The Moti Daman Fort is host to two beautiful lighthouses

DEV1.claim: Devka Beach in Nani Daman has dark sand and the 5.45 km Devka promenade (Namo Path); it is open 24x7.

evidence.quote: Considered one of the most photographed beaches in Daman, Devka Beach, situated in Nani Daman
Devka Promenade and Sea Front, affectionately known as the Namo Path, is a 5.45-kilometer pathway
Open: 24x7

JMP1.claim: Jampore Beach, 5 km from the Moti Daman jetty, is a quiet black-sand beach lined with casuarinas.

evidence.quote: 5 kilometres away from the Moti Daman Jetty, Jampore Beach with its pristine shores of soft black sand
Lined by spectacular groves of Casuarina trees

DIU1.claim: Diu is an island off Gujarat whose fort was built by the Portuguese in 1535; St Paul's Church is famed for its woodwork, and Panikotha is a fort in the sea.

evidence.quote: The captivating island paradise rests like a jewel off the coast of Gujarat.
Built by the Portuguese in 1535
Also known as the Church of Immaculate Conception, this 400-year-old marvel will mesmerise you with its intricate wood carvings
the Fortress of Panikotha

DIU2.claim: Nagoa Beach is Diu's crown jewel; the Naida Caves have striking rock formations.

evidence.quote: Treat the nature-lover in you by visiting the crown jewel of Diu at Nagoa Beach
Explore the mystical Naida Caves

INS1.claim: The INS Khukri Memorial honours the sailors lost when the ship sank off Diu in the 1971 war; open 9 am–9 pm.

evidence.quote: The INS Khukri Memorial stands as a timeless testament to the courage and honour shown by Indian Navy sailors during the 1971 Indo-Pakistan War.
The memorial commemorates the INS Khukri, a ship that sank near this very spot.
Opening time - 09:00 AM
Closing time - 09:00 PM

SIL1.claim: Silvassa, in Dadra and Nagar Haveli, has the 18th-century Church of Our Lady of Piety, the Om-shaped Nikhileshwar temple and Warli tribal painting. Visit October to March.

evidence.quote: the Portuguese-style Church of Our Lady of Piety , a majestic edifice dating back to the 18 th century
visit the Om Nikhileshwar Mahadev Temple , a captivating structure shaped like the sacred Om symbol
Explore the captivating world of Warli painting in Silvassa.
The best time to visit Silvassa is during the winter months, from October to March.

VAN1.claim: Vanganga Lake Garden in Silvassa covers about 7.58 hectares, with bridges, jogging tracks and over 40 film songs shot here.

evidence.quote: Spread across approximately 7.58 hectares
Over 40 Hindi hit film songs have been filmed here

LK_112.claim: 112 is India's single emergency number for police, fire and ambulance.

evidence.quote: 112 is now the pan-country single emergency number for all emergencies.

LK_VISA.claim: e-Tourist visa applications should be made at least 4 days before arrival, with a passport valid for at least six months.

evidence.quote: For e-Tourist and e-Business visa, Applicants of the eligible countries/territories may apply online minimum 4 days in advance of the date of arrival.
Applicant's passport should have at least six months validity at the time of making application for grant of e-Visa.

LK_UPI.claim: International visitors can pay by QR code using NPCI's UPI One World wallet after a passport-and-visa KYC check.

evidence.quote: The UPI One World wallet can be availed through authorized PPI issuers at airports, hotels, designated money exchange locations and other touchpoints, following a full KYC process based on a passport and valid visa.
